newsitem.title: INDIA: OPINION - WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.
newsitem.headline: OPINION - WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.

text.p: CHOPPY MOVEMENTS AHEAD is a trend analysis of the
30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index for the period April 7 to April 11 by analyst Mehmood Khan at Times Guaranty Financials Ltd

The Sensex pierced through its bullish trigger level at 3498.74 to reverse its downtrend directly uptrend. The follow-up through this break-out was not satisfactory. The index eased marginally, during Friday's trading and therefore, the newly-born bull trend is still vulnerable for a trend change.

The presence of a big gap, just above the current levels is possibly creating resistance to the current price movement. To get out of the danger from the bears, the index must find the strength to travel through this gap. The 21-day old downtrend with a trend capture of 17.72 percent from the top of 4029.56 terminated at 3315.36, making way for a minor new bull trend. Now the Sensex will have to decline below 3461.25 during the week to trigger bearishness. Even though the trigger level is just about 89.12 points below the last traded value, there is still the possibility of a trend reversal, if the current week's bull follow-up is not supported by aggressive bear pressure.

The minor rally from 3315.36, has retraced the decline of a lesser degree from 3796.22 by 55.48 percent (3581.94). The Sensex is encountering resistance at the First Fibbonaci Arc of the larger degree drawn from 4029.56 to 3315.36, the upmove in the current week will be resisted at the Arc at 3610-3670 levels. The Sensex has vital support at the trend-line drawn by taking connecting the bottom of 3316.15 (Feb.04, '97), 3316.71 (Feb. 26, '97), and the recent bottom of 3315.36 levels.

For the current week, the BSE Sensex, may find support at 3461, 3405 and 3368 levels, on the higher end it may encounter resistance at 3588 and 3610 level. The National Index may witness buying interest at 1484-1440 level and resistance at 1558 and 1587 level.
(The opinions expressed in this article reflect the views of the author only. They should not be taken as reflecting the views of Reuters)
